task_completion.description: The agent opens the Webots application and loads the drone world.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots interface is visible, showing a 3D view of a quadcopter and a scene tree on the left.

task_completion.description: The agent expands the DELIVERY_DRONE node and locates the four Propeller nodes (FRONT_RIGHT, FRONT_LEFT, REAR_RIGHT, REAR_LEFT).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scene tree shows the DELIVERY_DRONE node expanded with the four specific propeller names visible.

task_completion.description: The agent sets the first value of 'thrustConstants' to 0.00015 for all four propellers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The field editor or scene tree shows 'thrustConstants' set to 0.00015 (or 1.5e-04) for the selected propeller nodes.

task_completion.description: The agent sets the first value of 'torqueConstants' to 0.000006 for all four propellers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The field editor or scene tree shows 'torqueConstants' set to 0.000006 (or 6e-06) for the selected propeller nodes.

task_completion.description: The agent sets the 'fastHelixThreshold' to 75.0 for all four propellers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The field editor or scene tree shows 'fastHelixThreshold' set to 75 for the selected propeller nodes.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the modified world to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/tuned_quadcopter.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save World As...' dialog box is visible with the path /home/ga/Desktop/tuned_quadcopter.wbt entered, or a terminal command confirms the file exists at that location.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify the parameters rather than just editing the text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots scene tree and field editor values.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply run a python/bash script to overwrite the file without opening the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Webots application is the primary window in focus during the parameter modification steps.

integrity.description: The agent used the 'File' menu or shortcut to save the world within the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Webots 'File' menu is seen open or the 'Save As' dialog is visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must configure 4 propellers: FRONT_RIGHT, FRONT_LEFT, REAR_RIGHT, and REAR_LEFT. Required values: thrustConstants[0] = 0.00015, torqueConstants[0] = 0.000006 (6e-06), and fastHelixThreshold = 75.0. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Desktop/tuned_quadcopter.wbt. A 5% tolerance is acceptable for numerical values (e.g., 0.0001425 to 0.0001575).
